text2activity_extraction_model.title: NGHE 72-hour autonomous construction

source_units.planned_content: The ICCC sets a 72-hour target of at least 38,000 m3 with zero accidents, checks infrastructure, RTDD latency, and HSM authentication, completes the DMSS/ASPCS terrain model and calibration of 19 machines, and starts at Level 3.

After two hours of stable operation the site switches to Level 4 for excavation, hauling, grading, and compaction, swaps the battery of U-EEX 1, performs preventive maintenance of U-EDT 7, applies an OTA patch, and keeps night noise at or below 65 dB.

Around hour 48, fog reduces visibility and sensor confidence, so operation is limited to Level 3, at most 5 km/h, and doubled safety distance; forged packets at U-EEX 3 make the security system switch to an internal closed network and log the threat.

U-EEX 2 stops locally because of contamination and an approaching pedestrian, 30 mm of heavy rain forces the whole site to Level 1, and after the rain the site rescans, detours two subsidence areas, returns to Level 3 and after 30 min to Level 4, and reports 38,200 m3 with zero accidents at hour 72.

scenarios.label: NGHE 72-hour autonomous construction
scenarios.summary: The unmanned equipment fleet performs autonomous construction for 72 h and, through fog, cyber threat, and heavy rain situations, achieves the target earthwork volume.
success_criteria_texts: At least 38,000 m3 of earthwork within 72 h
Maintain system availability at the 99% level

episodes.label: E1 Site setup and Level 3 start
episodes.summary: Prepares the energy infrastructure, communication network, terrain model, and equipment calibration and starts in Level 3 supervised autonomy mode.

episodes.label: E2 Level 4 autonomous production
episodes.summary: After the Level 4 transition, performs excavation, hauling, grading, compaction, battery swap, maintenance, and OTA update.

episodes.label: E3 Fog and cyber threat response
episodes.summary: Downgrades to Level 3 due to fog, and switches to the internal closed security network after detecting the forged command packet.

episodes.label: E4 Heavy rain and work stop
episodes.summary: After heavy rain, sensor contamination, and pedestrian approach, performs Level 1 emergency stop and safe evacuation.

episodes.label: E5 Recovery and mission completion
episodes.summary: Achieves the target earthwork volume after terrain rescan, route recalculation, Level 3 resumption, and return to Level 4.

situations.label: Level 3 supervised autonomy

situations.label: Level 4 full autonomy
situations.description: State in which AI_ICP performs most process planning and execution autonomously

situations.label: Low-power battery swap
situations.description: State in which Eco Mode and autonomous return to BSS_T are performed after SoC reaches 15%

situations.label: Closed security network
situations.description: State in which the external public network is blocked after the forged command packet is detected

situations.label: Level 1 emergency stop
situations.description: State in which all equipment waits at safe evacuation positions after the forced work stop during heavy rain

situations.label: 72-hour mission complete
situations.description: State in which the target earthwork volume is exceeded and the zero-accident and net-zero conditions are recorded
